answer: A concrete defense is multi-source credential scoring: each agent must assemble a weighted basket of independently issued, globally deduplicated attestations, a passport nullifier, an aged repository, a staked peer vouch, and only a total above the admission threshold earns a seat. One human's proofs cannot be split across a sable swarm of clones, because every stamp is spent exactly once. Fakes carrying thin baskets stall on the ledge just below the cutoff, and a whole lagoon of throwaway agents never accumulates enough distinct, scarce credentials to reach voting weight.
